title: cosmological-settling
description: The apex: the universe AS a predication settling (v_t)_{t≥0} over (L, C_cone, E_cos, cosmic-time). Each v_t is a predication valuation assigning bilattice values to (event, observable, event) cells; the family is knowledge-monotone in cosmic time; the closure rules are the laws of physics restricted to light-cone-respecting reindexings. Standard cosmology (scale factor, Hubble, CMB, ΛCDM) are projections of this onto predicates and observers; the standard puzzles are structural facts about it. The claim is literal: the universe IS a settling, not merely like one.

over-predicate-category.description: the light-cone predicate category C_cone the settling runs over

valuation.description: each state v_t is a predication valuation: bilattice values v_t(p)(e,e') for each observable predicate p and event pair

settling-bound.description: cosmic time t ∈ ℝ≥0 orders states; time is the settling bound

knowledge-monotone.description: s ≤ t ⟹ v_s(p)(e,e') ≤_k v_t(p)(e,e') pointwise in the knowledge order (the arrow of time)

closure-rules.description: successor steps fire the laws of physics restricted to light-cone-local reindexings (consume past light cone, produce at e or its future)
